import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;

    static class FlowEdge {
        int to, rev;
        long flow, cap, cost;
        
        FlowEdge(int to, int rev, long flow, long cap, long cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static FlowEdge[][] adj = new FlowEdge[5000][5000];
    static int[] deg = new int[5000];
    static long minCost;

    static void init(int n) {
        minCost = 0;
        Arrays.fill(deg, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                adj[i][j] = null;
            }
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        minCost = Math.max(minCost, cap);
        adj[u][deg[u]] = new FlowEdge(v, deg[v], 0, cap, cost);
        deg[u]++;
        adj[v][deg[v]] = new FlowEdge(u, deg[u] - 1, 0, 0, -cost);
        deg[v]++;
    }

    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[5000];
    static int[] par = new int[5000];
    static long[] pot = new long[5000];
    static long[] dist = new long[5000];

    static void init_pot(int n) {
        Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
        for (int iter = 1; iter < n; ++iter) {
            for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
                for (int i = 0; i < deg[u]; ++i) {
                    FlowEdge e = adj[u][i];
                    if (e != null && e.cap > 0) {
                        if (pot[e.to] > pot[u] + e.cost) {
                            pot[e.to] = pot[u] + e.cost;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long mcf(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        dist[s] = 0;

        if (sparse) {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (vis[u]) continue;
                vis[u] = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < deg[u]; ++i) {
                    FlowEdge e = adj[u][i];
                    if (e != null && e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.to] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.to] + e.cost;
                        par[e.to] = i;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int u = s; u != -1; ) {
                vis[u] = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < deg[u]; ++i) {
                    FlowEdge e = adj[u][i];
                    if (e != null && e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.to] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.to] + e.cost;
                        par[e.to] = i;
                    }
                }
                u = -1;
                long best = INF;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                        best = dist[i];
                        u = i;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (dist[t] >= INF) return 0;

        long df = INF;
        for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
            int idx = par[u];
            FlowEdge rev = adj[u][idx];
            df = Math.min(df, adj[rev.to][rev.rev].cap - adj[rev.to][rev.rev].flow);
            u = rev.to;
        }

        for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
            int idx = par[u];
            FlowEdge rev = adj[u][idx];
            FlowEdge e = adj[rev.to][rev.rev];
            e.flow += df;
            rev.flow -= df;
            price[0] += df * e.cost;
            u = rev.to;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            pot[i] = Math.min(INF, dist[i] + pot[i]);
        }
        return df;
    }

    static long min_cost_flow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
        init_pot(n);
        long flow = price[0] = 0;
        while (true) {
            long df = mcf(s, t, price, n, sparse);
            if (df == 0) break;
            flow += df;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        final int source = 0;
        final int sink = n * T + 1;

        init(sink + 1);

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            addEdge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            addEdge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    addEdge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    addEdge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * (long)d + c);
                    addEdge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * (long)d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = min_cost_flow(source, sink, price, sink + 1, true);
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
